articles.title: Standard Chartered offers RLUSD custody in Dubai and plans LMAX collateral link
articles.snippet: Ripple previously gave LMAX $150 million in financing to integrate RLUSD into its institutional infrastructure.

articles.title: Ledger says unauthorized implant found in at least one device sold by CryptoBilis
articles.snippet: Ledger confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in a device linked to crypto losses at CryptoBilis, a Southeast Asian reseller. The company says confirmed cases are limited and its internal systems remain unaffected.

articles.title: Bitcoin's $19 billion wake-up call: One-year after flash crash, has crypto learned anything?
articles.snippet: The Oct. 10, 2025 flash crash wiped out billions in leveraged crypto bets. Traders now have better tools to spot risks, but the forces behind the selloff remain.

articles.title: South Korean bank launches Bitcoin-backed business loans: Report
articles.snippet: Jeonbuk Bank reportedly began offering Bitcoin-backed loans to corporate customers, with a third-party custodian holding the cryptocurrency used as collateral.

articles.title: Tech chief says EU can fend off rogue AI risk: Report
articles.snippet: Recent incidents at OpenAI ‌and Anthropic stoke global concerns and fears that rogue AI agents may venture beyond human control.
